---
title: "Data look"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyr)
setwd("~/git/BAMF/notebooks")
G_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_G.csv",header=TRUE)
F_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_F.csv",header=TRUE)
E_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_E.csv", header=TRUE)
X_ = read.csv(file = "../data/example_data_X.csv", header=TRUE)

N <- nrow(G_[,-1])
M <- ncol(X_[,-1])
P <- ncol(G_[,-1])
t <- G_[,1]
t <- (t - t[1])/(1e9)/3600
t<- diff(t)
X_ <- X_[,-1]
E_ <- E_[,-1]
F_ <- F_[,-1]
G_ <- G_[,-1]
F_ <- apply(F_, MARGIN=2, FUN = as.numeric)
```



```{r}
library(ggfortify)
imputed_ts_data <- apply(X_, MARGIN = 2, \(x){
  y=x
  y[is.na(x)]=mean(x,na.rm=TRUE)
  y
  } )
```

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(imputed_ts_data, scale. = TRUE)
autoplot(pca)
```


```{r}
library(vsp)
fa <- imputed_ts_data %>% as.matrix() %>% vsp( rank = 3)
```

```{r}
plot_varimax_z_pairs(fa)
```


```{r}
library(corrplot)
corrplot(cor(G_, as.matrix(fa$Z), use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
```


## sampling
 
```{r}
library(cmdstanr)
set_cmdstan_path("~/cmdstan")
file = "../models/bamf.stan"

mod <- cmdstan_model(file)
data_list <- list(n=N, m=M , p=P, X=X_, sigma=E_, timesteps=t, minerr=
    min((E_)) / 10, F=F_
)
```

```{r}

fit <- mod$sample(
  data = data_list, 
  seed = 123, 
  chains = 4, 
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 500 # print update every 500 iters
)
```
```{r}
library(posterior)
fit$diagnostic_summary()

```
```{r}
library(bayesplot)
fit$cmdstan_diagnose()
```

```{r}
mcmc_rhat(rhat(fit))
```

```{r}
mcmc_neff(neff_ratio(fit))
```

```{r}
which.max(neff_ratio(fit))
```


```{r}
draws <- fit$draws(format="df")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
G_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,1'))
G_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,2'))
G_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,3'))
```


```{r}
G_1 %>% pivot_longer(colnames(G_1), names_to="variables",values_to = "samples") %>% ggplot() + geom_point(mapping=aes(variables,samples))
```
```{r}
G1_mean <- G_1 %>% colMeans()
plot(G1_mean)
```
```{r}
corrplot(cor(G1_mean,G_))
```
```{r}
plot(G_[,1],G1_mean)
```

```{r}
plot(G_[,1],as.matrix(fa$Z)[,1])

```

## Look at the simplex


```{r}
plot(F_[1,])
plot(F_[2,])
plot(F_[3,])
summary(F_[1,])
```
```{r}
F_sparse = F_
F_sparse[F_sparse<0.005] <- 0

F_sparse <- apply(F_sparse, MARGIN = 2, FUN = \(x) {x/rowSums(F_sparse)})
plot(F_sparse[1,])
```
```{r}

data_list <- list(n=N, m=M , p=P, X=X_, sigma=E_, timesteps=t, minerr=
    min((E_)) / 10, F=F_sparse
)
```

```{r}
fit <- mod$sample(
  data = data_list, 
  seed = 123, 
  chains = 4, 
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 500 # print update every 500 iters
)
```

```{r}

draws <- fit$draws(format="df")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
G_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,1'))
G_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,2'))
G_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,3'))
```

```{r}
G1_mean <- G_1 %>% colMeans()
plot(G_[,1],G1_mean)

```


```{r}
plot(G_[,2],G_[,3])
```

## Sparsifying the simplex using the concentration parameter.

```{r}
alpha = 0.01
data_list <- list(n=N, m=M , p=P, X=X_, sigma=E_, timesteps=t, minerr=
    min((E_)) / 10, concentration= alpha*(rep(1,M))
)


```


```{r}
file = "../models/bamf_sparse.stan"

mod <- cmdstan_model(file)

fit <- mod$sample(
  data = data_list, 
  seed = 123, 
  chains = 4, 
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 500 # print update every 500 iters
)
```

```{r}

library(posterior)
fit$diagnostic_summary()
```

```{r}
fit$cmdstan_diagnose()

```

```{r}

draws <- fit$draws(format="df")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
G_1 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,1'))
G_2 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,2'))
G_3 <- as_tibble(draws) %>% select( matches('G\\[\\d+,3'))
```

```{r}
G1_mean <- G_1 %>% colMeans()
plot(G_[,1],G1_mean)
G_data <- data.frame(G_real=G_[,1], G_predicted=G1_mean)
summary(lm(G_real ~ G_predicted, G_data))
```
```{r}
bayesplot::pp_check(object = fit)
```
